name: Twenty
one_liner: Twenty is an open-source CRM platform offering schema-per-tenant REST and GraphQL APIs, workspace automation, and native MCP support.
access_note: API keys can be generated directly within any workspace under Settings > Developers > API, and Twenty is open source.

evidence.quote: Create an API key in Settings → Developers → API → + Create key.
Both are available as REST and GraphQL.
The recommended way to give an LLM agent (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, …) access to your workspace is the **Twenty MCP server**
